verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a research-agent platform, but the evidence never documents exporting results to document, spreadsheet, or reference-manager formats such as DOCX, PDF, CSV/XLSX, BibTeX or RIS. The pack only shows that agents produce cited reports and figures, and that users can look through generated artifacts and notebooks via the client. Those are adjacent features, not format export.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can export results to common formats, including documents, spreadsheets, and reference-manager files
